text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, T.M. Opera O and I are training on a dirt track, when…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Phew… Hmm?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could you bring me a mirror? I must confirm something about my beauty.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I'm concerned about the mud being kicked about while running. I would check that it hasn't soiled my face.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Not that anything could ever hinder my resplendence!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't see anything, but I go get a mirror for her anyway.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, that angle is perfect. Now, pardon me a moment…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It cannot be!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My beauty has reached such a magnitude without my knowledge?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: See for yourself. Do I not appear more dazzling and gallant than ever before?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… In recent races, I had sensed a difference in the crowd's gaze while being showered by their ovations.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But who would blame them? None are capable of resisting this magnificent aura!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You need not be shy. Look at me. Take aaall the time you need.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It is by natural law that flowers captivate. Truly, you must wish to spend your time gazing at me, the greatest flower of them all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Have the stretchers on standby for the next race. Some are bound to faint when met with this sight.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas… This is the burden I must bear for being so beautiful. But bear it I shall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's more fascinated with herself than usual.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sigh… To think, how gorgeous I've become…
choice_data_list: Um, you look the same to me.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… It seems your eyes are in need of refinement, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But fear not! I shall impart unto you the key to seeing the finest aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look upon me one hundred times every day. Hehe, I know. How could it be so simple?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Who better to study if you are to learn what beauty entails? Ah yes, write a report as well. I shall assign a grade for each one you submit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I'm forced to gaze upon Opera O's face for quite a long while.
